messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — there's an oversized bike box in the main lobby marked for 'Taylor Ramos'. No badge was picked up at the desk.
Front Desk: Courier dropped it around 10:12am, left it by the big planter. Asked to call the recipient.
Alex: Oh! That's probably the demo e-bike Taylor ordered. I can grab it if they want it staged in the garage.
Priya: Do we have a signed visitor for Taylor? I don't see any walk-in on the calendar.
Front Desk: No visitor in the system, Maya — courier said recipient will be by later. We held it instead of sending back.
Maya (People Ops): Hmm — we can't leave big packages in the open all day. Options: 1) Store in Mail Room 2) Put in Bike Garage 3) Ask courier to reattempt delivery with recipient present. Thoughts?
Ethan: Mail Room has limited space and the box is huge. Garage is safest.
Jordan: Garage sounds good. I can move it after lunch if someone signs the log (liability).
Front Desk: Added a temporary tag: `#2601 - Taylor Ramos - held by Front Desk` — also logged with CourierBot.
CourierBot: Delivery 845712 — status: held at reception. Reattempt window: 48 hours. Tracking: https://ship.example/845712
Priya: If Taylor arrives without a badge, Front Desk — can we issue a guest pass? Preferably a same-day QR badge.
Front Desk: Yes, we can issue a QR visitor pass. Need name + company. We'll require ID at pickup.
Maya (People Ops): OK I'll DM Taylor to confirm arrival ETA and whether they'd like us to transfer to Garage. If no reply by 3pm we'll move to Garage and note pickup instructions.
Alex: If you move it to Garage, can someone snap a photo of where it is so I know which bike it is? :biking_man:
Jordan: Yep, will take a pic. Also moving it requires two people for the corner lift — Jordan + Alex or Jordan + Maya.
Ethan: I can help at 3:15pm.
Priya: FYI Taylor's calendar shows a 4pm slot today, so likely pickup then.
Maya (People Ops): Great — plan: Front Desk holds until 3pm, try contacting Taylor. If no response, Jordan & Ethan transfer to Garage at 3:15pm, Alex will stage and take photo. Front Desk will prepare QR guest badge and ID check instructions.
Alex: Sounds good. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Taylor (via DM to Maya): "Hey, I'm running 15 min late — please leave it in the garage and I'll pick up with ID. Thanks!"
Maya (People Ops): Got it — moving to Garage at 3:15. Jordan/Ethan/Alex on lift. Front Desk: badge ready on pickup.
Front Desk: Badge prepared as: Taylor Ramos / Personal / Expires end of day. ID check confirmed on pickup.
Alex: Photo attached in DM thread (parking spot #B3) — box labelled 'red/left sticker'.
Jordan: Box moved to Garage spot B3. Signed log: Jordan, Ethan — 15:22.
Maya (People Ops): Closing the loop — Taylor picked up at 16:05, showed ID, signed the log. All good. Leaving notes for future: oversized item policy and garage transfer SOP draft incoming.
Priya: Legend. Also maybe we add a short blurb to the visitor check-in email about bringing ID for package pickups.
Maya (People Ops): Good call — will add. Thanks team! :sparkles:
